title: xdac~
description: `xdac~` is a multichannel audio output object like `dac~` that accepts channel ranges and explicit channel lists, such as `xdac~ 1:3 5 7:12`. Its output-channel mapping can be queried or set with `@channels`, and methods including `reverse`, `rotate`, `shuffle`, and `side2circle` reorder the mapped channels; left-clicking opens the audio properties dialog.
